claims.text: Under GSAS Committee on Regulations and Discipline procedures, students are asked to respond in writing to an allegation ordinarily within two weeks. Hearings are conducted by a panel of at least four members (including a usually non-voting secretary; three voting members including at least one student form a quorum). Decisions are made by secret ballot on a preponderance of the evidence; the committee recommends a sanction to the dean, who determines the penalty. Disciplinary decisions take immediate effect. Students may submit a written appeal to the Committee of Review no later than five business days after the committee decision. The Committee of Review (three members) may decline action or request reconsideration; on reconsideration, the committee cannot find culpability if previously exonerated or impose a more severe penalty. Scope is restricted to GSAS; research misconduct is referred under Research Misconduct procedures; undergraduate cases follow separate Yale College Executive Committee procedures.

claims.claimText: Under GSAS Committee on Regulations and Discipline procedures, students are asked to respond in writing to an allegation ordinarily within two weeks. Hearings are conducted by a panel of at least four members (including a usually non-voting secretary; three voting members including at least one student form a quorum). coursework.en: Instructors specify permitted AI use in course syllabi. Students must not use AI tools in coursework or evaluations unless explicitly authorized.
coursework.zh: 任课教师在课程教学大纲中明确 AI 许可范围。未经任课教师明确允许，学生不得在课程作业或学术评价中使用 AI 工具。

exams.en: Permissibility of generative AI during exams is determined by individual instructors in course policies and syllabi; AI use is not permitted unless authorized by the instructor. There is no university-wide blanket permission or mandatory in-writing format unless specified in the course syllabus.
exams.zh: 考试中是否允许使用生成式 AI 由任课教师在课程政策及教学大纲中规定；未经教师明确许可，不得使用 AI。全校范围内无统括性许可，除课程教学大纲特别规定外，亦无全校统一的书面形式硬性要求。

disclosure.en: GSAS students must properly attribute AI-generated text used in submitted work and follow faculty-specific rules for other AI assistance. They must be able to explain their research and writing process, including providing draft history when requested. This is a GSAS rule, not a uniform disclosure rule for every Yale student.
disclosure.zh: 文理研究生院（GSAS）学生须正确注明提交作品中使用的 AI 生成文本；其他 AI 辅助须遵循相关教师的具体规定。学生须能够说明研究和写作过程，并按要求提供草稿历史。这是 GSAS 的要求，不是对所有耶鲁学生或一切 AI 辅助统一适用的披露规则。

privacy_data.en: Yale's September 2023 Provost guidance says not to enter confidential, legally restricted, Moderate-risk or High-risk Yale data into an AI tool. The current institutional directory separately lists service-specific data classifications, including Clarity for High-risk data with special ePHI and DUA conditions, while Radiate web search is limited to Low-risk data. Follow the service's access restrictions and applicable data agreements; these classifications do not settle authorization for every dataset.
privacy_data.zh: 耶鲁 2023 年 9 月教务长指引表示，不要将机密、受法律限制、中风险或高风险的耶鲁数据输入 AI 工具。当前校内目录另列各服务的数据分类，例如 Clarity 可处理高风险数据但有专门 ePHI 环境及 DUA 条件，Radiate 网络搜索仅限低风险数据。须遵守具体服务的访问限制及适用数据协议；目录分类不能替代对每份数据集使用权限的判断。

approved_tools.en: Yale provides institutional tools including Microsoft Copilot, Clarity, and Claude Enterprise, and permits Zoom AI Companion with account controls. Tool availability does not confer academic assessment permission.
approved_tools.zh: 耶鲁大学提供 Microsoft Copilot、Clarity 及 Claude Enterprise 等校内核准工具，并在受控设置下开通 Zoom AI Companion。工具的开通并不创设课程考核许可。

research_publication.en: Yale Library guidance requires that use of generative AI with licensed electronic resources must comply with vendor license agreements, which often prohibit commercial text and data mining or feeding content into external AI models.
research_publication.zh: 耶鲁大学图书馆指引明确要求，将生成式 AI 与订阅电子资源结合使用时，必须严格遵守数据库供应商许可协议，协议通常禁止商业性文本与数据挖掘或将内容输入外部 AI 模型。

academic_integrity.en: Inserting AI-generated content into submitted work without proper attribution constitutes an academic integrity violation. Under GSAS 2026–2027 standards, graduate students must consult relevant faculty before using AI in coursework or research and must be prepared to articulate and demonstrate their drafting process if requested, but there is no universal requirement for all students to log every prompt. Disciplinary responses are managed by the Committee on Regulations and Discipline; written student statements are ordinarily due within two weeks.
academic_integrity.zh: 在提交作品中混入 AI 生成内容且未适当归属构成学术诚信违规。依据 GSAS 2026–2027 年规范，研究生在将 AI 用于课程或研究前须咨询相关教师，并在被询问时能够阐明与展示起草过程，但这并非要求所有学生强制记录每一次提示词。纪律处理由规章与纪律委员会管理，学生书面申辩声明通常应在两周内提交。

teaching_guidance.en: Yale Poorvu Center guidance and Provost directives affirm that instructors have full authority within each course to determine whether and how students may use AI when completing assignments. Faculty members are expected to provide clear instructions on permitted AI use and requirements for attribution, and instructors are encouraged to adapt Yale model policies for their specific course and learning goals.
teaching_guidance.zh: 耶鲁大学普尔武中心指引与教务长指南明确，任课教师在各门课程内拥有确定学生在完成作业时是否及如何使用 AI 的完全自主权。学校期望教师就学术工作中生成式 AI 工具的获准使用范围及致谢要求给出明确说明，并鼓励教师根据具体课程及学习目标调整采纳耶鲁示范政策。

security_procurement.en: Yale Provost guidance asks that individuals considering acquiring an AI product please conduct an initial review of the tool to ensure it conforms to institutional security requirements. Poorvu Center guidance specifies that classroom AI use must comply with FERPA, and instructors cannot require students to create external accounts for tools Yale does not directly license.
security_procurement.zh: 耶鲁大学教务长指南提示，拟获取或引入 AI 产品的人员请先行审核该工具以确保其符合学校机构安全要求。普尔武中心指引明确指出，课堂使用 AI 必须遵守《家庭教育权利和隐私法案》（FERPA），教师不得强制要求学生为耶鲁未直接许可的工具注册外部账户。

draft-claim-yale-gsas-discipline-committ.text: Under GSAS Committee on Regulations and Discipline procedures, students are asked to respond in writing to an allegation ordinarily within two weeks. Hearings are conducted by a panel of at least four members (including a usually non-voting secretary; three voting members including at least one student form a quorum). Decisions are made by secret ballot on a preponderance of the evidence; the committee recommends a sanction to the dean, who determines the penalty. Disciplinary decisions take immediate effect. Students may submit a written appeal to the Committee of Review no later than five business days after the committee decision. The Committee of Review (three members) may decline action or request reconsideration; on reconsideration, the committee cannot find culpability if previously exonerated or impose a more severe penalty. Scope is restricted to GSAS; research misconduct is referred under Research Misconduct procedures; undergraduate cases follow separate Yale College Executive Committee procedures.

evidence.quote: Student statement. Students will be asked to respond in writing to the allegation. Providing a written statement allows the student to present their perspective on events and any broader context or other information that will help the Coordinating Group and committee to better understand the situation. Written statements will ordinarily be due to the secretary two weeks after the student receives notification of the charge. In their statement, students should admit or deny allegations against them. In some cases, the student may admit responsibility for some portion of the allegations and deny others.

evidence.quote: A hearing panel will have a minimum of four members, including the secretary (or dean’s designate) who does not typically vote. Voting members of the panel must include the chair or vice chair, one faculty member and/or dean of the graduate school, and one student member. The presence of three voting members will constitute a quorum, provided that at least one student member is present. A majority vote will decide questions before the hearing panel. In the event of a tie vote, the secretary or other committee designee will cast a deciding vote.

The committee’s decision will be made by a simple majority of voting members present. The secretary will vote only in the event of a tie. This decision will be made by a preponderance of the evidence, voted on by secret ballot, and will be final.
